g.text: Is it normalized? Yes to PLA count; not to tissue area or ChAT availability
Each bar is an observed descriptive contrast, not a significance test. Reversing subtraction reverses its sign only.
The overlap-area row asks a different question. Pooled objects are shown only to expose unequal animal weights.
